detail: On the Ides of March, senators led by Brutus and Cassius stab Caesar to death at a Senate meeting in the Curia of Pompey.
label: 15 March 44 BCE
note: Location corrected: the Senate met in the Curia of Pompey, next to Pompey's Theatre, because the regular Senate House was being rebuilt.
title: Julius Caesar is assassinated
tldr: Senators led by Brutus and Cassius stab Caesar on the Ides of March.
